about: Anima is an underground house music brand on the Isle of Man, curating unique events at venues across the island. From Douglas clubs to one-off nights in the glens, no two are the same.
homeTagline: Underground house nights on the Isle of Man. Discover your true inner self.
homeVideoText: Live sets on YouTube, curated playlists from our selectors on SoundCloud — a taste of what Anima sounds like between shows.
homeSoundcloudText: Not recordings from our nights — these are playlists carefully curated by the Anima selectors. Every track is hand-picked and sequenced by the people behind the decks: the underground house they're playing, digging for and can't stop coming back to. Press play and let it run.
galleryIntro: After movies and photos from Anima nights across the Isle of Man. Hover over a film to preview it, or tap it to watch with sound.
musicIntro: Live sets, warehouse highlights, and a look behind the scenes from Anima nights. New uploads on our YouTube channel after every show.
musicSoundcloudText: Playlists carefully curated by the Anima selectors — not recordings from our nights, but hand-picked, properly sequenced selections of the underground house they're playing and digging for right now. Follow along to hear the sounds that shape our lineups before they land on the dancefloor.
storeComingSoonText: The Anima store is on its way. Check back soon.
